ruleDefinitions.name: Potential Download/Upload Activity Using Type Command
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects usage of the "type" command to download/upload data from WebDAV server

sequences.query: ((process_command_line = RGX(".*type\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\>\\ \\\\\\\\.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*type\\ \\\\\\\\.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\>\\ .*")))
